prompt: Call the middle-school science fair finals like WrestleMania. The volcano kid is defending champion.
response:
**LADIES AND GENTLEMEN... ARE YOU READY?!**

WELCOME to the JEFFERSON MIDDLE SCHOOL GYMNASIUM — the most ELECTRIFYING venue in all of seventh-grade science! Tonight, TRI-FOLD POSTER BOARDS will FALL! Hypotheses will be SHATTERED! And ONLY ONE STUDENT will walk out with that blue ribbon!

*"Also Sprach Zarathustra" blasts over the gym speakers*

AND HERE HE COMES! Weighing in at 94 pounds, hailing from the back corner table near the water fountain... THE DEFENDING CHAMPION... THE MAGMA MAESTRO... THE BARON OF BAKING SODA... **TYLER "THE ERUPTION" HENDERSON!**

Two years running, folks! TWO YEARS this kid has ridden that papier-mâché mountain to GLORY! And look at it tonight — he's added RED LED LIGHTS! The crowd of parents holding phones is going ABSOLUTELY BANANAS!

But WAIT—

*lights flicker*

BUSINESS. IS ABOUT. TO PICK UP!

Coming down the center aisle... it's the CHALLENGER... the eighth-grade phenom... MADISON "THE HYDROPONIC HAMMER" CHEN! She grew LETTUCE! WITHOUT SOIL! Under THREE different light wavelengths! WITH A CONTROL GROUP! MY GOODNESS, THE METHODOLOGY! SHE'S GOT ERROR BARS ON HER GRAPHS, JIM! ERROR BARS!

And don't sleep on the dark horse in booth seven — DYLAN "POTATO POWER" RODRIGUEZ! He's got a CLOCK! Running on a SPUD! The kid is UNHINGED and the judges KNOW IT!

OH NO — OH NO — Tyler's volcano is erupting EARLY! The vinegar's LOOSE! IT'S ALL OVER THE JUDGE'S CLIPBOARD! Mrs. Patterson is FURIOUS! SOMEBODY STOP THE MATCH!

Madison seizes the moment — she's handing out LETTUCE SAMPLES! THE JUDGES ARE EATING THE EVIDENCE! THIS IS UNPRECEDENTED!

The scores are in... 

**NEEEEW CHAMPION! NEW CHAMPION!** MADISON CHEN WINS THE BLUE RIBBON!

Tyler is stunned. The dynasty... is OVER. But folks — he's shaking her hand. Sportsmanship! Right here in the gymnasium that smells faintly of vinegar and floor wax!

GOODNIGHT EVERYBODY — AND REMEMBER TO PICK UP YOUR PROJECTS BY THREE O'CLOCK OR THEY GO IN THE DUMPSTER!
